description: The Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (KAMA) endpoint calculates the KAMA for a specified financial instrument, returning a time series of values that reflect the average price adjusted for market volatility. This endpoint helps users identify trends by smoothing out price fluctuations while remaining sensitive to significant price movements.
name: Kaufman adaptive moving average
